format: WSDC Registry Events: owners and directors

source.edition: Version 2026.1C (page footers; the file name says 2026.1B)
source.quote_free_summary: Event directors and owners must not perform chief judge, judge or scoring duties; their spouses and immediate family may not perform chief judge or scoring duties. Director means anyone involved in hiring judges or scoring staff, or named director; owner means anyone with a vested financial interest.

requirement: Explicit event-level designations of owners, directors and family; block judge/chair/scorer assignment, chief judge and scoring-operator designation for them; fail closed without a valid attestation.
enforcement_point: Planned (design: docs/competition/governance/judging-integrity/OD-05-conflicts-design.md section 6A): database triggers on officials, designations and result versions. Not built.
interpretation_notes: Today any manager can be added as judge or chair (audit J-08W). DanceFlow account roles are not WSDC roles; the director definition is functional, so only an attestation can cover it. Design only (PR-A): nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed. Applies only to WSDC-declared events; never imposed on NDCA, UCWDC or Studio/Custom.
